title: Ash Gourd Stir-fry
excerpt: An easy ash gourd stir-fry recipe
subtitle: An easy ash gourd stir-fry recipe
body:
Here is how to make ash gourd stir-fry very easily.

## Ingredients

- Ash gourd (1)
- Green chilies (2–3)
- Onion (1)
- Turmeric powder (1 teaspoon)
- Chili powder (1 teaspoon)
- Salt (to taste)
- Oil (1 tablespoon)

![Ash gourd stir-fry](https://recipes.milon.im//assets/images/recipes/chalkumra-vaji.jpg)

## Method

First, wash the ash gourd and grate it. You can also dice it finely if you prefer. Heat oil in a pan and add diced onion. Add turmeric powder, chili powder, and salt, stir well, then add the ash gourd. Keep stirring, then cover after a few minutes.

You do not need to add extra water — the ash gourd will release plenty of moisture and cook in its own juices. Wait until the liquid dries up. When it is nearly dry, add a few green chilies split down the middle. Take off the heat after 2–3 minutes.
